newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Ningbo Marine plans 36.9 mln A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China Ningbo Marine plans 36.9 mln A share IPO.

text.p: China's Ningbo Marine Transport Co Ltd expects to launch an initial public offering of 36.9 million A shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on March 20, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission has approved the issue, priced at 6.45 yuan per share, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company will simultaneously issue 4.1 million shares to its staff at the same price, the official said, adding the staff shares will not be listed until six months after the A share float.
The firm has named Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co as the main underwriter, he said.
The company, based in Ningbo city in eastern Zhejiang province, engages in marine cargo transport along the east coast of China.
Ningbo Marine, which already has five cargo ships, planned to use the proceeds to buy another five or six vessels, the official said.
The company forecast 1997 net profit of 78.85 million yuan, up from 60 million yuan estimated for 1996 and 47.2 million yuan in 1995.
It had audited after-tax profit of 49.3 million yuan in the January-October period of 1996.
The official said profits rose on improved efficiency and reduced costs.
After the A share offer, the company will have 164 million outstanding shares, consisting of 123 million legal person shares, 36.9 million A shares and 4.1 million staff shares.
